ideas.title: Commit Message Coach for Student Repos
ideas.pitch: A CLI that scores your commit messages and suggests clearer rewrites before you push.
ideas.problem_solved: Students push vague commit messages that make their history unreadable to reviewers.
ideas.target_users: CS students preparing GitHub profiles for internship applications.

milestones.title: Parse commits
milestones.description: Read the last 20 commits from a local repo and print them.

milestones.title: Score messages
milestones.description: Apply rule-based scoring and print a score per commit.

milestones.title: Suggest rewrites
milestones.description: Call the LLM for a rewrite and show a diff.

milestones.title: Ship the hook
milestones.description: Install as a commit-msg hook and publish to PyPI.

ideas.portfolio_tip: Record a 20-second terminal GIF for the README and link the PyPI page on your resume.

ideas.title: Lecture Notes Search with SQL Full-Text
ideas.pitch: Search every lecture PDF you own and jump straight to the page that answers your question.
ideas.problem_solved: Finding one definition across a semester of slide decks takes far too long.
ideas.target_users: University students with large folders of course PDFs.

milestones.title: Extract text
milestones.description: Turn a folder of PDFs into page-level text rows.

milestones.title: Index pages
milestones.description: Load rows into an SQLite FTS5 table and query it from the shell.

milestones.title: Search API
milestones.description: Expose a /search endpoint that returns ranked snippets.

milestones.title: Minimal UI
milestones.description: Serve one HTML page with a search box and results.

milestones.title: Write it up
milestones.description: Benchmark query time and document the design.

ideas.portfolio_tip: Lead the README with a before/after timing table and explain your ranking choice.

ideas.title: Dorm Laundry Wait-Time Predictor
ideas.pitch: Predicts when the laundry room is free using a week of logged machine availability.
ideas.problem_solved: Students waste trips to a laundry room that turns out to be full.
ideas.target_users: Students living in shared housing with communal machines.

milestones.title: Log data
milestones.description: Build a tiny form that records busy or free with a timestamp.

milestones.title: Explore
milestones.description: Plot occupancy by hour and weekday in a notebook.

milestones.title: Model
milestones.description: Fit a baseline classifier and report accuracy.

milestones.title: Present
milestones.description: Render a weekly best-time chart on a single page.

ideas.portfolio_tip: Show the chart at the top of the README and state the model's accuracy honestly.
